# Introduction — The Paradox of Abundant Speech

Investigate and articulate a structural risk arising from the deployment of generative AI by a small number of powerful technology companies.

Commercial risk management, content moderation, and control over digital infrastructure can constrain legitimate expression while simultaneously making mass production of other content extraordinarily cheap.
